blocks.text: Company description
Example Climate Systems Inc. designs and manufactures heating, ventilation and air conditioning equipment for commercial buildings.
Further information: https://climate-systems.example
Product description
The EX-650 is a water-cooled centrifugal chiller with a two-stage compressor and oil-free bearings, using the low-GWP refrigerant R-1233zd(E).
Trade names: EX-650
The product range covers 350 to 1,150 tons; the 650-ton configuration is assessed.

blocks.text: Cut-off criteria

Processes whose total contribution is less than 1% of the total mass and primary energy of the declared or functional unit may be excluded, provided that the total of excluded flows does not exceed 5% of mass and energy per module. No known flows were deliberately excluded.
The following flows were excluded:
Allocation

Where a manufacturing site produces several products, energy, materials and wastes were allocated on a mass basis. Recycled content enters the system burden-free (cut-off approach); burdens of material recycling at end of life are attributed to the system that uses the secondary material.
Data sources and data quality

Primary data was collected from the manufacturer for the reference year. Background data was taken from the LCI database listed in the declaration summary, selected for technological, geographical and temporal representativeness.
The LCA was modelled in EcoMetric 1.0 using ecoinvent 3.12 cut-off.
All results are given per 1 ton of chilling capacity.
X = module declared; MND = module not declared; ND = not declared. Results for modules A1–A3, A4, A5, B, C and D should not be summed.

Contribution analysis
The interpretation is based on TRACI 2.1 results for “Manufactured in US”.

The product stage (A1–A3) accounts for 0.5% of global warming potential across the declared modules, excluding module D. Module B6 — Operational energy use contributes 98.6% of total global warming potential over the 75-year building service life. Module B6 — Operational energy use contributes 98.8% of total ozone depletion potential over the 75-year building service life. Module B6 — Operational energy use contributes 98.8% of total acidification potential over the 75-year building service life. Module B6 — Operational energy use contributes 98.9% of total eutrophication potential over the 75-year building service life. Module B6 — Operational energy use contributes 98.7% of total smog formation potential over the 75-year building service life.

Assumptions

The selection of secondary datasets to represent the supply chain is a significant value choice; no generic dataset is a perfect fit. Supply-chain-specific data would improve the accuracy of the results.
Limitations
Results represent potential environmental impacts and do not predict impacts on specific endpoints, the exceedance of thresholds, safety margins or risks.

Environmental declarations from different programs (ISO 14025) may not be comparable. Comparison of the environmental performance of products using EPD information shall be based on the product's use and impacts at the building level, and EPDs may not be used for comparability purposes when not considering the building use phase as instructed under the PCR. Full conformance with the PCR allows EPD comparability only when all stages of the life cycle have been considered, when the EPDs comply with all referenced standards, use the same sub-category PCR and use equivalent scenarios.
